user.title: Add signal
user.description: Paste an advertisement copied from the Advertisement Monitor, or enter its fields yourself.

paste.title: Paste advertisement
paste.description: In Settings → Devices & services → Bluetooth → Advertisement Monitor, select the device's advertisement and choose Copy to clipboard, then paste it here. You can also paste a raw packet as hex. You can review every field on the next step.

data_description.advertisement: The copied JSON, or raw advertising data as hex.

manual.title: Add signal
manual.description: Define an advertisement to broadcast when the button is pressed. Fill in only the fields the target device checks; empty fields are left out of the packet.

data_description.name: Name of the button, e.g. Projector power on.
data_description.manufacturer_id: Company ID, decimal (70) or hex (0x0046). The Advertisement Monitor shows it in decimal.
data_description.payload: Manufacturer data as hex, without the company ID; BlueZ adds that itself.
data_description.appearance: GAP appearance value, e.g. 961 for a keyboard.
data_description.advertisement_type: Peripheral is connectable; broadcast is not.
data_description.duration: How long to keep advertising after each press.
data_description.adapter: Integration default uses the adapter chosen in the integration options. You can also type hci0 or a MAC address.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Rarely needed fields. Older BlueZ versions ignore TX power, intervals and raw data unless bluetoothd runs with --experimental.

data_description.service_data: One uuid=hex per line, e.g. fe95=3020bc03.
data_description.include_tx_power: Add a TX power level field to the packet.
data_description.tx_power: Transmit power to request from the controller.
data_description.discoverable: Set the LE General Discoverable flag.

error.invalid_manufacturer_id: Enter a company ID from 0 to 65535, decimal (70) or 0x-prefixed hex (0x0046).
error.invalid_number: Enter a whole number in range.
error.invalid_service_data: Service data must be one uuid=hex per line.
error.invalid_solicit_uuids: Solicit UUIDs must be 16-bit (1812) or 128-bit Bluetooth UUIDs.
error.invalid_data: Raw AD structures must be one type=hex per line, with type from 0 to 255.
error.invalid_interval: The minimum interval can't be greater than the maximum interval.
error.manufacturer_data_incomplete: Manufacturer ID and manufacturer data must be set together.
error.invalid_monitor_json: That doesn't look like an advertisement copied from the Advertisement Monitor.
error.invalid_raw: The raw advertising data is malformed.
error.multiple_manufacturers: This advertisement has manufacturer data for several company IDs ({ids}); only one is supported per signal. Enter the fields manually instead.
error.empty_advertisement: The advertisement has no fields that can be replayed.

send.name: Send advertisement
send.description: Broadcasts a BLE advertisement for a few seconds. Returns once BlueZ has accepted it; the advertisement stays on air in the background.

manufacturer_id.name: Manufacturer ID
manufacturer_id.description: Company ID, decimal (70) or 0x-prefixed hex (0x0046). Requires manufacturer data.

payload.name: Manufacturer data
payload.description: Hex bytes after the company ID. Don't include the ID; BlueZ adds it.

appearance.name: Appearance
appearance.description: GAP appearance value, e.g. 961 for a keyboard.

advertisement_type.name: Advertisement type
advertisement_type.description: Peripheral is connectable; broadcast is not.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to keep advertising, 1 to 10 seconds.

adapter.name: Adapter
adapter.description: hci0, a MAC address or a BlueZ path. Defaults to the integration's adapter.

service_data.name: Service data
service_data.description: Mapping of service UUID to hex bytes.

include_tx_power.name: Include TX power
include_tx_power.description: Add a TX power level field to the packet.

tx_power.name: Requested TX power
tx_power.description: Transmit power to request from the controller.

discoverable.name: Discoverable
discoverable.description: Set the LE General Discoverable flag.

data.name: Raw AD structures
data.description: Mapping of AD type (0-255) to hex bytes.
